name: vision_unet_seg_bad
title: The same U-Net segmentation trainer with eight planted defects
origin: domain-vision round 1: the dirty twin of vision_unet_seg

expected.defect: UNet.forward ends in nn.Sigmoid while the objective is nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss
expected.why: the sigmoid is applied twice, so the loss saturates near 0.5 and the gradient all but disappears

expected.defect: the same double sigmoid on the validation path
expected.why: the reported validation loss is on the same wrong scale as the training loss, so neither is comparable to anything
every update uses the previous batch's gradients, and the first update uses none at all
the Dropout2d bottleneck fires and every DoubleConv's BatchNorm2d keeps updating its running statistics from validation images

expected.defect: the training loader does not shuffle
expected.why: the folder listing is sorted, so each batch is a run of consecutive frames from the same source image

expected.defect: the epoch loss is accumulated as a live tensor
expected.why: the autograd graph of every batch is retained for the whole epoch

expected.defect: the validation loop is not wrapped in torch.no_grad()
expected.why: a 512x512 segmentation graph is built for every validation image and never used

expected.defect: VAL_AUGMENTATION still carries A.HorizontalFlip and A.RandomBrightnessContrast
expected.why: the validation IoU moves between epochs because the augmentation moved, so the checkpoint is chosen on noise

expected.defect: the validation split is carved out with random_split and no generator
expected.why: the validation set is a different 10% on every run, so two runs are not comparable

forbidden.why: the loaders are built inside build_loaders(), reached only from main() under the __main__ guard
the evaluation loaders still pass shuffle=False
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is still called in every batch - the planted defect is the ordering, not the absence
optimizer.step() is still called in every batch
no backward() call is inside a no_grad region
CosineAnnealingLR is still stepped once per epoch
there is no softmax and no CrossEntropyLoss in this project
the images and masks are still moved to the model's device
every nn.Module subclass still calls super().__init__()
the down and up stacks are still nn.ModuleList instances
torch.save still writes state_dict()s and torch.load still passes weights_only=True

gaps.what: iou_score thresholds the raw model output at 0.5 instead of a probability, so with the sigmoid head removed the metric would call every pixel under logit 0.5 background - no rule checks the operand of a segmentation threshold
